evidence.detail: The class extends R436 CustomInterfaceBuilder and builds exact root widget 51200 with the literal title 'Player IP / UID Matcher'.
The interface constructs a scrollable 100-row match list with online/non-match state presentation and per-row Action controls, fixing the screen as a player identity-match result viewer.
The builder owns exact IP Address and UID ban-status text, geolocation text, Ban all / Ban this IP/UID controls, ordering by total matches or most recent, and Search new name navigation.
Outside the builder itself, exact v308 references rs/n/c/U only from R436 CustomInterfaceRegistry; no unrelated gameplay/UI owner constructs it.
The recovery names the client-side matcher/admin interface only. It does not infer server-side identity resolution, moderation policy or geolocation implementation details.

candidates.note: Exact-v308 descriptive name from the screen's own Player IP / UID Matcher title and identity-match/moderation controls. Server-side matching and moderation semantics are not inferred.
